about: World scale standard in voxels (1 voxel = 1 world unit), matched to Pirate Nation by class: each class range comes from the PN models of that kind (see the README, 'Scale standard'). PN footprints use a 16-voxel tile (a 6x6 building is 96 wide). Every world asset declares one class; its bounds must fit the class ranges. height = y size, length = the larger of x/z, width = the smaller of x/z, largest = the largest of all three.

prop.use: small objects: crates, barrels, tables, signs, tools, consoles, rocks as props

person-size.use: objects sized to a person: vending machines, thrones, armour stands, statues of people, iron maidens, cryo pods, stasis tubes, porta-potties, payphones, bookshelves

coffin.use: anything a body lies in: coffins, sarcophagi, caskets (flat or upright)

door.use: free-standing doors, gates, archways and portals a person walks through (PN pirate archway 82×90, haunted archway 83×115)

vehicle-door.use: doors a vehicle drives through: garage doors

lamp.use: street lamps, lamp posts, lantern posts

tall-prop.use: structures taller than a lamp but not buildings: radio masts, windpumps, bell frames, pylons, obelisks

building.use: houses, halls, shops, hangars, warehouses: 5x5 to 13x13 tiles, doors at least doorHeight

tower.use: towers, spires, water towers, bell towers

wall.use: castle walls and gatehouse-like wall sections

vehicle-small.use: one-rider vehicles: motorbikes, hover bikes, brooms

vehicle.use: cars, trucks, carts, wagons, carriages, rovers, buggies, fighters, saucers

vehicle-large.use: buses, ships, airships, freighters, siege towers

creature-small.use: animals smaller than a person: bats, rats, crows, dogs, slimes, wisps, drones

humanoid.use: person-sized creatures: zombies, goblins, skeletons, mummies, aliens, ghosts, robots

creature-large.use: creatures bigger than a person: werewolves, horses, griffins, spiders, mechs, ents, gargoyles

creature-boss.use: boss monsters: dragons, queens, behemoths, vampire lords

fence.use: fence and railing segments; the length is whole 16-voxel tiles so segments line up on the PN grid

kit.use: modular building pieces a person walks among: dungeon walls, corners, pillars, stairs (one storey or more tall, whole tiles long)

tile.use: flat ground tiles: floors, grates, road sections (whole tiles)

wreck.use: wrecked vehicles as scenery; the same size as the live vehicle

terrain.use: rocks, ground tiles, craters, pools, bridges, plants, wrecks, planets as scenery
